title: HR Manager industrial staffing
description:
Job Title: Recruitment Manager Industrial Staffing
 Location: Dahej, Gujarat
 Industry: Industrial Staffing / Manpower Solutions
 Department: Recruitment / Talent Acquisition Job Summary We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Recruitment Manager to lead our industrial staffing recruitment team at Dahej, Gujarat. The candidate will be responsible for managing end-to-end recruitment, handling client relationships, coordinating bulk manpower hiring, and ensuring timely deployment of skilled, semi-skilled, and unskilled workers for industrial and manufacturing clients. The ideal candidate should have strong leadership, client management, workforce planning, and industrial recruitment experience. Key Responsibilities 1. Team Management & Leadership Lead, manage, and mentor the recruitment team to achieve hiring targets. Allocate recruitment requirements among team members and monitor daily performance. Track team productivity, recruitment metrics, and closure rates. Conduct regular review meetings and ensure timely fulfilment of manpower requirements. 2. Industrial Recruitment & Manpower Planning Manage end-to-end recruitment for industrial, manufacturing, factory, and plant-based requirements. Handle bulk hiring for skilled, semi-skilled, and unskilled manpower. Recruit candidates for profiles such as machine operators, technicians, electricians, fitters, welders, production workers, helpers, and supervisors. Develop sourcing strategies through job portals, consultants, referrals, local networks, and walk-in drives. Ensure candidates meet client requirements and are deployed within agreed timelines. 3. Client Relationship Management Manage existing client accounts and build long-term business relationships. Coordinate with clients to understand manpower requirements, job specifications, and hiring priorities. Conduct regular client meetings and provide recruitment progress updates. Handle escalations, resolve hiring-related issues, and ensure client satisfaction. Identify opportunities to expand existing accounts and support new client acquisition where required. 4. Recruitment Operations & Reporting Maintain daily recruitment trackers, candidate databases, deployment records, and hiring reports. Monitor turnaround time (TAT), joining ratios, attrition, and recruitment costs. Coordinate with HR, payroll, operations, and site teams for smooth candidate onboarding and deployment. Ensure recruitment documentation and processes comply with company policies and applicable labour regulations. Required Skills Strong leadership and team management skills. Excellent client handling and relationship management abilities. Expertise in industrial staffing, bulk hiring, and manpower planning. Strong negotiation, communication, and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage multiple client requirements and meet tight deadlines. Proficiency in MS Excel, recruitment trackers, and job portals such as Naukri. Experience & Qualification Experience: 5–8 years in recruitment or staffing, preferably with industrial staffing experience and team-handling exposure. Education: Graduate in any discipline; an MBA/PGDM in HR is preferred. Preferred Background: Industrial staffing companies, manpower outsourcing, contract staffing, manufacturing, or plant recruitment. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Achievement of monthly hiring and deployment targets. Timely fulfilment of client manpower requirements. Team productivity and recruitment closure rates. Client satisfaction and account retention. Candidate joining ratio and early attrition rate. Recruitment turnaround time and cost efficiency.

Key Skills: Talent acquisition,End To End Recruitment,Management,Hiring,Hrsd,Recruitment,Acquisition,End To End
